readable.SW:
Write the specification for this work from everything decided so far: the requirement, the analysis, the design, and what the reviewers raised and how it was resolved. Put the complete Markdown document in the `document` field; `summary` is one paragraph about it. Write for an AI that will implement from this text alone and cannot ask questions: (1) Purpose and scope, plus explicit non-goals. (2) Glossary of every term used. (3) Decisions, each with its reason and the alternatives that were rejected. (4) Requirements as short numbered statements (REQ-001, REQ-002, ...), each one testable, using MUST / SHOULD / MAY. (5) Interfaces and data shapes written out exactly (names, types, errors). (6) Acceptance criteria as Given / When / Then, each pointing at the requirement it checks. (7) Open questions, and anything the conclusions contradict, listed rather than guessed. No filler, no marketing language, no vague words such as 'appropriate'. Record only what was concluded; if the discussion never settled a point, put it under open questions.
